describe.description: A stout, low-bodied quadruped is shown in right-side view angled slightly toward the viewer, standing on a small patch of bare dirt with scattered dry leaves and sparse green tufts. The body is broad and arched, with a pale, cream-colored, transversely ridged and folded underbelly and a back, sides, top of the head, and long flattened tail completely covered in large, overlapping, rounded brown-gray scales. The head is wide, flat and blunt-snouted with a slightly smiling mouth, small round nostrils at the tip, and large prominent eyes. Six dark fleshy stalks fringed with dense reddish feathery filaments project from the top and side of the head and neck. The four limbs are thick, fleshy and wrinkled with pale gray-pink skin, ending in broad five-toed clawed feet that support the animal above the ground.

describe.description: A stout four-legged creature shown in three-quarter view facing to the right, standing on a small patch of ground. It has a broad flat blunt-snouted amphibian-like head with large round eyes and a wide straight mouth, a pale soft wrinkled underbody and thick limbs, and the top of its head, back, sides and long tapering tail are covered in overlapping large brown-gray scales. Multiple dark tapered stalks fringed with reddish feathery filaments protrude from the sides and top of its head and neck.
